thread:
Amanda: alert - sharp spike in 5xx for hosted inference eu-west2 since ~09:44 UTC, ~28% 502/504 across gateway routes :warning:
Raj: seeing it on alerts too, digging into gateway logs now
Amanda: customer tickets coming in (multiple). quick example from curl against /v1/generate:
```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: redwood-gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{\"error\":\"upstream read timeout\"}
```
Support Liaison: escalated from GleamOps (customer id: C-98721) — they report timeouts then auth retries causing token-billing hits, on a high-traffic batch job
Jordan: metric view - packet retransmits and cross-AZ tail latency jump at 09:43:50 UTC, spike concentrated on az eu-west2-b and eu-west2-c paths
Jordan: dropping an mtr sample:
```
Start: 2026-03-17 09:46:12 UTC
HOST: svc-host -> 10.0.5.1
1.|-- 10.0.5.1 0.3% 1.2ms
2.|-- 198.51.100.45 12.7% 18.4ms  (provider transit)
3.|-- 203.0.113.9 30.4% 48.1ms  (egress AS64500)
```
NetOps: seeing BGP withdraws and AS path churn from AS64500 around 09:43-09:45 UTC, provider ticket 678901 opened. routing flaps match retransmit window
Raj: logs show gateway reties -> upstream connection resets, auth service flaky when requests are retried across AZs, example gateway error snippet:
```
ERR [gateway] upstream_read_timeout id=gw-12 conn=reset upstream=10.10.10.7:8080 route=/v1/generate
WARN [auth] token verification error: network timeout -> retrying
```
Kevin: short mitigation - can we force smart-routing to prefer eu-west1 for affected customers and enable short-circuit fallback to cached KV response for embeddings?
Amanda: initiating policy shift for high-risk customers now (will only touch traffic for accounts with SLA). command:
```
# apply routing override
redwoodctl routing override --region eu-west2 --fallback-region eu-west1 --selector 'tier:enterprise' --ttl 300
```
Deploy Bot: routing override request accepted, rollout started (10% -> 100% over 12m) :rocket:
Support Liaison: informing GleamOps: "we're routing you to eu-west1 temporarily, expect <200ms improvement, will follow up with root cause"
NetOps: provider reports partial convergence, they are blackholing 2x peering links for maintenance — working on re-advertise path. rough ETA 35-50m
Raj: adding temporary retry budget change to reduce auth-service cascades (lower client retries)
SRE Bot: snapshot of alert group attached to incident #INC-2026-212 (automated)
Amanda: repro steps for support/debug (if you need to repro locally):
1) run the curl above repeatedly from an eu-west2 host (or a VM in same AZ)
2) run `mtr -r -c 50 198.51.100.45` and look for >10% loss
3) tail gateway logs: `kubectl -n gateway logs -l app=gateway --since=10m`
Jordan: confirmed that when traffic is routed to eu-west1 the 5xx rate drops to normal baseline in our test pool
Support Liaison: customers updated, ticket comments appended with mitigation and ETA
Kevin: next steps - keep provider engaged, consider short BGP community to prefer alternate peering, follow-up postmortem owner: Raj, customer comms owner: Support Liaison
Amanda: thanks all — will update this thread with provider updates and when we close the rollback. :thumbsup:
